message: I remember a stormy winter night when my phone decided to take an unexpected vacation right as the lights flickered. It’s funny how technology can fail us when we need it most, isn't it? That’s why I always keep a few handy tips in my back pocket for when the weather turns wild. This guide from Ready.gov offers some solid advice to help you stay prepared, even when your tech goes on strike. What’s your go-to storm survival tip?
